scheme_name: PM-USP Central Sector Scheme of Scholarship for College & University Students (NSP UG)
authority: Department of Higher Education, Ministry of Education, Government of India
benefit: ₹12,000 per annum for 1st, 2nd, and 3rd year of regular Under-Graduate (UG) degree study (BA/BSc/BCom/BTech/MBBS/BCA) via direct DBT

criteria.label: Full-time regular Under-Graduate (UG) degree enrollment
criteria.plain_description: Candidate must be pursuing a full-time regular undergraduate course (BA, BSc, BCom, BTech, MBBS, etc.) from an AICTE/UGC recognized college or university.
criteria.source_clause: PM-USP Guidelines for Central Sector Scheme of Scholarship Clause 3(i)
criteria.remediation: Upload college admission receipt or bonafide certificate proving enrollment in a regular UG degree.

criteria.label: Academic qualifying score in Class 12 / Higher Secondary (>= 75% or 80th percentile)
criteria.plain_description: Candidate must score above 80th percentile in relevant stream in Class 12 board examination (minimum 75% aggregate score).
criteria.source_clause: PM-USP Guidelines Clause 3(ii) - Academic Percentile Cut-off
criteria.remediation: Provide Class 12 board marksheet verifying aggregate marks >= 75%.

criteria.label: Gross annual parental / family income ceiling (<= ₹4,50,000 per annum)
criteria.plain_description: Total annual family income from all sources must not exceed ₹4,50,000.
criteria.remediation: Upload a valid digital Income Certificate issued by competent revenue authority proving income <= ₹4.5 Lakh.

criteria.label: Aadhaar seeded bank account for direct DBT transfer
criteria.plain_description: Candidate must possess a valid Aadhaar card linked with active bank account.
criteria.source_clause: PM-USP Guidelines Clause 6 - DBT Disbursal Mandate
criteria.remediation: Upload Aadhaar card seeded with bank account for DBT.

criteria.label: Non-duplication clause (not receiving another central/state scholarship)
criteria.plain_description: Student must not be currently in receipt of another concurrent central or state government scholarship.
criteria.remediation: Confirm that student is not claiming another concurrent government scholarship.

application.office_name: College Nodal Officer (INO) / State Education Department
documents_to_carry: Student Aadhaar Card and Seeded Bank Passbook
process_steps: Complete One-Time Registration (OTR) on National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in)
Log in and apply under Department of Higher Education -> Central Sector Scheme of Scholarship for College and University Students
Upload Class 12 marksheet, income certificate, and fee receipt
College Institute Nodal Officer (INO) verifies enrollment and marks online
Ministry of Education sanctions scholarship of ₹12,000/yr directly via PFMS DBT
